Question 14
?

A particle P moves along the x-axis in the direction of increasing x. When the displacement of P from the origin O is x meters, the velocity is given by v(x)=e−2xm/s. Initially, P is at the origin O. Find x as a function of time t.

a
 x(t)=2tln⁡(t+2)
b
 x(t)=t2ln⁡(t+2)
c
 x(t)=ln⁡(2t+1)
d
x(t)=2ln⁡(4t+1)
e
x(t)=12ln⁡(2t+1)
